task: Evolve the existing Template Factory media manifest into a canonical Media Planner / Compiler that converts proven Constraint Plan semantic media requirements into immutable Asset Briefs, validates concrete manifest fulfillment, emits bounded repair actions, supports atomic media-state promotion, and preserves deterministic lineage without generating or selecting assets through a parallel authority.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Factory already has concrete media manifests, role/count/aspect constraints and asset states, while the proven Constraint Planner now emits semantic media roles and visual-language constraints. These layers are disconnected: concrete assets are authored manually and semantic intent is not compiled into immutable asset briefs, lineage, bounded repair or promotion semantics.
observableOutcomes: Constraint Plan semantic media roles compile into deterministic immutable Asset Briefs with technical role, count, aspect ratio, page scope, art direction and lineage.
Existing Factory media manifest remains the concrete asset authority; the Media Planner validates it rather than replacing it.
Required semantic roles cannot disappear, bind to incompatible technical roles, or be satisfied by unrelated assets.
Media planning reports technical/internal-reference/ready fulfillment separately and emits bounded repair actions instead of arbitrary source-code mutation.
Asset state promotion is pure, atomic and fail-closed across planned → internal-reference → ready transitions.
Generator Readiness consumes Media Planner validity without making actual image generation a prerequisite or creating a new Control Plane gate.
Distinctness inputs are carried forward as exclusions/art-direction constraints, while similarity scoring remains the separate anti-clone wave.
unresolvedRisks: Semantic roles such as hero-scene and collector-product currently do not map to generic Factory roles such as hero and product.
If bindings live only on individual assets, missing future assets cannot be planned deterministically.
If Media Planner mutates page documents or generates files directly, it becomes a parallel compiler/Builder authority.
If internal-reference assets count as fully production-ready, Product Owner acceptance can be falsely green.
Media distinctness must not be falsely claimed before cross-template scoring exists.

in: Canonical versioned Media Plan / Asset Brief contract.
Explicit semantic-role bindings inside existing Factory media manifest.
Constraint Plan → Media Plan deterministic compilation.
Manifest/asset fulfillment validation and bounded repair diagnostics.
Generator Readiness integration and maturity promotion with adversarial proof.
Loot Vault v2 only as existing accepted canary declaration.
out: Actual image generation or external provider selection.
Dynamic Page Schema composition or section placement.
New Control Plane gates or media-specific completion authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Media planning becomes a compiler input upstream of dynamic production and directly influences template identity. The highest practical assurance is deterministic immutable briefs, explicit semantic bindings, fail-closed manifest validation, bounded repair outputs, pure state transitions, source lineage and adversarial tests while preserving the existing manifest as concrete asset authority.

acceptanceCriteria: One canonical versioned Media Planner compiles a valid Constraint Plan and semantic bindings into immutable deterministic Asset Briefs.
Every required semantic media role in the Constraint Plan has exactly one explicit binding.
Bindings remain inside the existing Factory media manifest and map semantic roles to technical role/count/aspect/page constraints.
Concrete assets may declare semanticRole and are validated against the binding that owns them.
Planner distinguishes structural validity, technical fulfillment and ready fulfillment.
Planner emits only bounded repair actions and never edits arbitrary source code or Page Schema.
Atomic promotion rejects illegal state jumps and invalid reference/local source evidence.
Generator Readiness fails closed on invalid Media Planning but does not require ready=true for every asset during pre-production.
FACTORY-MEDIA-PLANNER-COMPILER becomes PROVEN only after implementation + adversarial tests.
FACTORY-DISTINCTNESS-ANTI-CLONE remains EVOLVE and is not implicitly promoted.
invariants: Factory media manifest remains concrete media authority.
Constraint Plan remains semantic production constraint authority.
Media Planner creates briefs/validation/repair lineage only; it does not become Page Schema or Runtime authority.
UNKNOWN semantic role, invalid binding or illegal promotion never passes.
Internal-reference is acceptable for bounded technical QA only, never equivalent to ready Product Owner media.
Concrete paths remain outside Genome and Constraint Plan.

failureModes: Constraint Plan requires hero-scene but manifest has only generic hero assets with no semantic binding.
Binding exists but concrete assets use a different technical role/aspect ratio.
A required semantic role has a binding but insufficient technical or ready assets.
Media asset is promoted directly from planned to ready without reference-stage evidence.
Media plan hash remains unchanged after art-direction or binding mutation.
Media Planner writes concrete media paths into Genome or Constraint Plan.
edgeCases: Multiple concrete assets may satisfy one semantic brief while one asset may not satisfy multiple semantic roles implicitly.
Optional semantic roles may have bindings without becoming required by Product Owner intent.
A technical role may support multiple semantic roles only through separate explicit bindings and assets.
Internal-reference assets can satisfy technical QA counts but not ready fulfillment.
A ready asset must be package-owned/local and cannot rely only on referenceSrc.

alternatives.summary: Compile semantic roles through explicit manifest bindings into Asset Briefs and validate existing assets.
alternatives.reason: It bridges proven semantic constraints to the existing concrete manifest without hidden heuristics or a second asset authority.

alternatives.summary: Infer hero/product/editorial roles from semantic-role strings.
alternatives.reason: String heuristics are brittle, non-explainable and would silently miscompile new template types.

alternatives.summary: Let an image generator decide roles, placement and source files directly.
alternatives.reason: This would bypass Constraint Planner, manifest authority and bounded production lineage.

specialistReviews.finding: The correct owner path is Constraint Plan → Media Planner → existing Factory media manifest, not a new media subsystem beside the Factory.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep bindings on the manifest and compile a read-only immutable Media Plan consumed by readiness/compiler layers.

specialistReviews.finding: Generic media roles alone cannot prove semantic intent; concrete assets can accidentally satisfy the wrong visual purpose.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require explicit semanticRole bindings and validate each attributed asset against role/aspect/page constraints.

specialistReviews.finding: Asset briefs need enough art direction to preserve template identity but must not prescribe exact images and recreate clone skins.
specialistReviews.resolution: Carry type/genome media language, rules and exclusion signals, not concrete image content.

specialistReviews.finding: Media planning must not mutate runtime page documents or commerce state.
specialistReviews.resolution: Planner returns immutable briefs, fulfillment and repair diagnostics only; current Factory wiring remains authoritative.

challenge.scenario: Required semantic role has no explicit binding.
challenge.finding: Planner cannot deterministically convert semantic intent to technical production requirements.

challenge.scenario: Asset claims collector-product but uses editorial technical role.
challenge.finding: Concrete fulfillment could satisfy the wrong production slot.
challenge.resolution: Validate semanticRole asset role/aspect/page scope against its brief.

challenge.scenario: Only internal-reference assets satisfy a brief.
challenge.finding: Technical QA may be possible but Product Owner readiness is not.
challenge.resolution: Expose technicalFulfilled separately from readyFulfilled; never equate them.

challenge.scenario: planned asset is promoted directly to ready.
challenge.finding: Atomic promotion and evidence lineage are bypassed.
challenge.resolution: State machine permits only planned→internal-reference and internal-reference→ready.

challenge.scenario: Reference promotion lacks HTTPS reference source or ready promotion uses non-local src.
challenge.resolution: Promotion validates evidence/source policy before returning a new manifest.

challenge.scenario: The manifest declares two different bindings for semantic role collector-product: one maps it to technical role product/4:5 and another maps the same semantic role to editorial/3:2.
challenge.finding: Without uniqueness enforcement, compilation would depend on declaration order, producing two incompatible Asset Brief interpretations for the same Constraint Plan role.
challenge.resolution: Reject the manifest before brief compilation with MEDIA_PLANNER_SEMANTIC_ROLE_DUPLICATE so exactly one binding can own each semantic role.

challenge.scenario: Binding semantic role is outside Constraint Plan allowed roles.
challenge.finding: Manifest can smuggle media identity not authorized by Type/Genome/PO constraints.

challenge.scenario: Art direction changes but hash/lineage remains stable.
challenge.finding: Downstream compiler could reuse stale evidence.
challenge.resolution: Deterministic hash covers constraint source and full Asset Brief content.

proofPlan: Unit/adversarial proof for deterministic Asset Brief compilation, binding uniqueness, semantic bounds and hash mutation.
Manifest fulfillment proof for technical vs ready counts, role/aspect/page mismatch and bounded repairs.
Atomic promotion state-machine proof for legal and illegal transitions/source evidence.
Generator Readiness combination proof using Loot Vault v2 existing accepted media and Constraint Plan.
Maturity proof promotes only Media Planner while leaving distinctness/dynamic compiler gaps intact.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Canonical Media Planner compiles Constraint Plan semantic roles and existing manifest bindings into deterministic immutable Asset Briefs with lineage, fulfillment and bounded repair diagnostics.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Media Planner does not replace Factory manifest, Page Schema, Runtime or Constraint Plan authority.

requirements.requirement: Missing/out-of-bounds bindings, mismatched concrete assets and illegal media-state transitions fail closed and never produce valid planning or promotion.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Internal-reference or unrelated assets cannot be reported as ready semantic fulfillment.

requirements.requirement: Media Planner carries distinctness constraints but cross-template anti-clone capability remains EVOLVE until dedicated executable similarity proof exists.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Media Planner completion cannot promote cross-template distinctness.

notes: Fourth Brabus hardening wave. Genome, Type System and Constraint Planner are PROVEN and lifecycle-closed. Media Planner/Compiler now bridges semantic constraints to the existing concrete Factory media manifest. Actual image generation and anti-clone scoring remain separate. Template #3 remains forbidden. Canonical Media Planner projection reconciled: impacted subsystems are builder-template-system/customer-account/inventory-fulfillment-authority/payment-checkout-order-authority/shared-storefront/storefront-ui; SQ-NK-005 and SQ-NK-014 do not apply; guard digest afc442ca. Proof files remain proof-only, outside semantic must-edit authority.
